6.134 rsNonAggregateInMatrixCell
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsNonAggregateInMatrixCell is a non-critical error that will occur when a MatrixCell element contains
an expression that contains a field that is not an aggregate function.
